anya: proposing split manifest: core + mode_extensions to avoid hosted-only keys leaking.

matt: agree. main risk is migration compatibility.

olivia: suggest capability registry + adapter probe endpoint so planner reads live capabilities.

reza: core should contain capability names only; extensions host implementation details and secret refs.

infra-bot: ACTION created INFRA-4500 "cap-registry" ticket.

anya: will draft RFC and converter tool. plan is shadow-read for 2 weeks then flip.

matt: ensure adapter API remains backward compatible during transition.

olivia: include UI rendering checklist in the RFC.

anya: thanks, posting draft tomorrow.
